style: Deep purple and magenta space background, glowing particle trails, colorful falling sand pixels.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). Images 1, 2, 4 and 5 are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record. Image 3 is new: the old one framed a chained fireball inside a monitor bezel, which matched neither the tether nor the demolition chamber. gen antigrav_deconstruction --only 3, then finish antigrav_deconstruction --only 3.

images.prompt: Low-angle wide shot of a huge derelict space station suspended inside a demolition chamber, industrial lights, twisted metal and broken hull plating, floating debris and particle streams, a small demolition ship in the lower corner with a glowing tether.

Close dynamic shot of a station module breaking apart, hundreds of colorful particles bursting outward, solid chunks, glowing gas and liquid droplets separating, a glowing ball at the point of impact.

Side view of a tall rectangular demolition chamber in space, like a glass terrarium. In the middle floats a blocky space station built from colorful bricks in red, teal, yellow and violet, with chunks already broken off. Below it, a wide glowing tray at the bottom of the chamber is filling with layers of colored sand and pooled liquids, red dust heaped beside a green puddle. At the top of the chamber an upside-down tray collects rising clouds of pink and white gas. Between them streams of tiny colored pixels fall down and rise up. A small flat paddle-shaped spaceship hovers below the station, a glowing orange ball on a thin shimmering energy tether flying from it into the bricks.

Portrait of a sleek demolition spacecraft in three-quarter view with a tethered ball glowing with elemental energy, station debris scattered behind it, particle streams around the ship, dramatic upward lighting.

Wide view of derelict stations floating in demolition sectors, new starships built from reclaimed materials traveling between them, a nebula in the background, glowing demolition chambers and a construction yard where particle streams become sleek ships.
